resolvedFinding.closure: The fixed four SELECTs return explicit string keys and to_jsonb(t)::text row_text. Exact SQL-generated text stays inside JSON strings through pg and both raw and hash transport. Baseline schema/projection fences refuse V1 comparison. Default comparison refuses additions; explicit allow-new preserves every baseline row while reporting additions.
